children: Tonix Pharmaceuticals promoted Thomas Englese to Chief Commercial Officer, effective immediately, to lead and expand commercial activities for TONMYA and other marketed products.
Thomas Englese, previously EVP Commercial Operations since 2024, is promoted to Chief Commercial Officer to lead sales, marketing, access.
He will continue overseeing TONMYA U.S. launch and commercial support for Zembrace SymTouch and Tosymra.
Company cites encouraging launch trends, access wins, and focus on expanding prescribers, patients and sales for TONMYA.
Englese brings prior CCO and commercial leadership experience at Tris, Aziyo, Mallinckrodt and roles at Baxter, Pfizer.
